local_context.value: Okatie is an unincorporated suburban community west of Hilton Head Island; Wikipedia gives 24.6% of residents aged 65 and over (its demographic figures cite the Bluffton QuickFacts page, so treat as approximate). Sun City Hilton Head, an age-restricted planned community in the Okatie area, has close to 10,000 permanent residents. Okatie is named for the Okatee River, an estuary of Port Royal Sound.

neighborhoods.value: Sun City Hilton Head, Riverbend, Oldfield

place_entities.value: Sun City Hilton Head; South Carolina Highway 170 (Okatie Highway); Okatee River estuary (named in the Okatie article)

permit_office.value: Beaufort County Building Codes for unincorporated Okatie; parts of Okatie lie inside Bluffton, Hardeeville and Port Royal, whose town/city offices issue permits there, so the office depends on the parcel (county phone 843-255-2065)
